reid: Heads-up — saw a burst where customers on prod-us-east hit saturated primary model (gpt-open-v1) and started getting 429s. We should consider automatic fallback to a compatible variant in-region before rejecting.

emma: +1. Important to honor tenant reserved capacity — we can't spill reserved customers to best-effort variants without consent. Maybe a policy per-customer: allow_spill = true/false.

kai: agree. propose policy: threshold pct (e.g. 85%) triggers attempt to route to compatible variants in same region, then cross-region as last resort. Also respect tenant_priority and reserved_capacity. Here's a sketch:

```yaml
fallback_policy:
  trigger_utilization: 0.85
  prefer_same_region: true
  fallback_order:
    - model: gpt-open-v1-q8_128
      stopgap: true
    - model: gpt-open-v1-4bit
  tenant_rules:
    reserved_only: false
    honor_reservations: true
``` 

sara: console UX notes: need a toggle on rollout to opt-in to auto-spill, plus per-tenant fallback view and a histogram of fallbacks / latency delta. Also a banner when spill occurs :warning: 

reid: Also need to be careful with prompt/content parity — quantized variants can change outputs. Do we want a probed eval step before routing to fallback? maybe run a lightweight sampling check for top-k stability.

emma: billing: mark tokens consumed on fallback as 'fallback_variant' so cost attribution correct and customers can audit. Also alert on >1% fallback rate per route.

kai: implementation note: do async check on KV cache compatibility; if KV mismatch, don't fallback (will add latency/regressions). we should prefer 'transparent' fallbacks where model_id changes but request_id preserved.

ops-bot: note: created ticket PLAT-3245 to track API + console changes. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PLAT-3245 :white_check_mark: 

sara: ok, i'll mock console wires by EOD and attach to PLAT-3245. small follow-up: telemetry event names — `fallback.attempt`, `fallback.success`, `fallback.latency_delta_ms`.

reid: cool. next sync tomorrow to pick defaults and rollout plan. :raised_hands:
